name: FLIP Grid Expansion
note: Click a tile and the detail panel is measured, inverted onto that tile's rect, then played back on a spring — real FLIP, not a fade. The SVG sparkline draws itself with a unique runtime gradient id, header and footer stagger in, and Close or Escape FLIPs it home and restores focus.

name: Shared Element Morph
note: One shared tile lives between two cards, each holding an empty slot for it. A velocity-based spring (k=190, c=21) drives a single progress value that lerps position, scale and corner radius from the measured slot rects, so it overshoots and settles like a real object; the cards brighten off the same value and the tile idles on a sine bob.
html: spring · shared element

name: Iris Clip Reveal
note: Each scene is revealed by an animated clip-path circle grown from the exact pointer coordinates out to the farthest corner, with a ring pulse launched from the same point and a caption that staggers in from whichever side you clicked. Keyboard activation reveals from centre; it opens itself on mount.

name: Page Turn Fold
note: A real 3D leaf with two backface-hidden faces rotates about the spine while a shade gradient on each face tracks the angle every frame. Drag either page to scrub the turn and release to glide to the nearer state; buttons and an idle auto-turn keep it moving, and page copy is re-rendered per spread so the leaf always carries the right content.

name: Curtain Slat Wipe
note: Nine slats scale down from the top on a 34ms stagger to cover the scene, the copy swaps behind them, then they scale away from the bottom in reverse order — one CSS transition-delay expression drives both directions. A rAF progress bar counts down to the next auto wipe and the button jumps the queue.
html: Act I Overture Nine slats close, the set changes, they lift.

name: Dealing Card Stack
note: Cards spring out of the deck on an overshoot curve with a 70ms stagger and flip face-up mid-flight via rotateY on a preserve-3d inner, each layer owning its own transform so hover-lift, deal and flip never fight. Collecting re-shuffles the fan angles, and the resting stack breathes.
html: tap deal to fan out

name: Crossfade With Scale
note: The outgoing slide scales past 1.0 and blurs out while the incoming one rises from 0.92 — the two overlap so it reads as a dissolve, never a cut. A 17s Ken Burns drift keeps the art alive underneath, the caption re-staggers on every change, and hover or keyboard focus pauses the rAF progress bar.

name: True Height Accordion
note: Panel height is measured from the real content box — no max-height guess. Heights are committed to the DOM first so layout is final, then replayed from the old value with the Web Animations API, which lets the rail marker spring to the exact settled position of the newly opened head while the rows stagger in on transform and opacity.
html:
Reads the real content box, then animates to it. No magic numbers, no max-height guess.
Each line lifts 55ms after the last. Transform and opacity only. The rail marker springs to the open head.
Interrupt mid-flight and it re-measures.
